[အနု+ဟရ+ယ+မာန။ မောဂ်၊နိသျ၊နှာ-၇၉၇-ကြည့်။]
U: ANUHĪRAMĀNA：[prp] đang được giúp đỡ，cứu trợ

DOP: anuhīramāna mfn. [ pass. part.pr. of *anu 1 + harati], being held over ; D II 15, 9 (setamhi chatte ~e [ a tuṭṭhubha pāda], Ce, Ee so; Be, Se anudhāriyamāne) = M III 123, 20 ( Ce, Se so; Be anudhāriyamāne; Ee anubhīramāne); — see also anudhāriyamāna.

anūhata.p: [Na+ūhata] (ti) Google Translate Not deducted, not rejected, not cut.
a: မနုတ်-မပယ်-မခွါ-မဖြတ်-အပ်သော။

C: anūhata：a. [an-ūhaññati 的 pp.] 不被根絶的，不被破壞的.
S: anūhata：a. [an-ūhaññati の pp.] 根絶されざる，破壊されざる.
D: Anūhata，【形】 未根绝的，未除根的。（p23）
B:
anūhata：anūhata（ti）

[na+uīhata]
[န+ဦဟတ]
P: Anūhata，（adj.） [pp. of an + ūhaññati，ud + han] not rooted out，not removed or destroyed Th.1，223 = Nd<sup>2</sup> 97<sup>4</sup>； Dh.338 （= asamucchinna DhA.IV，48）. （Page 45）
U: ANŪHATA：[a] không trừ tận gốc rễ
K:
anūhata：＂အနူဟတ（တိ）
[န+ဦဟတ]
မနုတ်-မပယ်-မခွါ-မဖြတ်-အပ်သော။

anūhata：အနူဟတ（တိ） （အန်+ဥဟတ）
မနုတ်အပ်သည်။ မပယ်ရှားအပ်သည်။

[ pp prob. of uddharati qv; S. uddhṛta, cf BHS ūhata], extracted, eradicated ; Nidd II 270, 18 (~ā samūhatā uddhatā samuddhatā); — anūhata , mfn. , not removed; not extracted, not rooted out ; Dhp 338 (taṇhānusaye ~e; Dhp-a IV 48, 11 : arahattamaggañāṇena ~e asamucchinne); Th 223 (taṇhāsalle ~e; Th-a II 87, 3 : ~e anuddhate); — see also ūhacca 1 .
